study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized cerebellar damage predicts the presence of behavioral disorders in children with brainstem tumors

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative models built with Gaussian Process Regression (GPR).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Using volumetric data from the 26 cerebellar regions, we established normative models with Gaussian Process Regression (GPR), incorporating age and gender as covariates

nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: This workflow ultimately yielded volume measurements for 26 cerebellar lobules, which were analyzed for their associations with behavioral outcomes.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex/gender covariates in the GPR normative model.
